text: Which of the following is a consequence of parametricity for System F?
choices: Every term of type ∀α.α is the identity
Every term of type ∀α.α is of any type A
There is no term of type ∀α.α
Every term of type ∀α.α→α is the identity
explanation: ∀α.α has no closed inhabitants (it corresponds to ⊥ under C-H); ∀α.α→α is inhabited only by the identity.
